title: Nomadar Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Nomadar Corp., a small-cap company listed on NASDAQ (NOMA), filed a Form 8-K disclosing an addendum to an existing Land Lease Agreement with its controlling shareholder Sport City Cádiz S.L., along with a binding purchase option for 130,000 square meters of land in Puerto de Santa María, Spain for approximately $4.45 million (€3.79 million). The land is intended for the company's JP Financial Arena real estate development project.
key_points: Nomadar Corp. and Sport City Cádiz S.L. entered into an addendum to their November 17, 2025 Land Lease Agreement on April 9, 2026.
The addendum grants a 3-year initial lease term (extendable by 2 years) for property in Puerto de Santa María, Spain.
Simultaneously executed purchase option: 130,000 square meters for €3,792,100 (~$4.45 million) within 90 days.
Purchase option must be exercised in increments of no less than 100,000 square meters.
Both the Board of Directors and Audit Committee approved and ratified the agreements on April 12, 2026.
The property is the intended site for Nomadar's JP Financial Arena real estate development project.
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate real estate transaction by a micro-cap company. It has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. The filing contains standard SEC boilerplate and forward-looking statements language.
